provenance.description: M3b first connected picking/packing slice: 6 small burst orders on the accepted main-warehouse geometry/stock/products/resources/units; no inbound deliveries; finite-cohort run for SUPPORTED_STAGE_COMPLETE.
assumptions: Derived from fixtures/operations/main-warehouse.json sha256 c6e4f208835e31de2554850fa618953bb6f9a1b03c360b137c784bd5112660cb (23520 bytes), cargo-c2 model: room, racks, obstacles, products, locations, initial stock, home assignments, mobile units (4 pickers + 2 putaway), and all resource coordinates/capacities/durations are unchanged FROM THE PARENT (the historical ce33a9c5/70ec57ab revision pair is preserved in oracles/git history, never rewritten).

Constructed fields: id, seed, provenance, orderSchedule (6 burst orders B-01..B-06 at 0/5000/10000/15000/20000/25000ms, 3-4 items each, single-trip loads), empty deliverySchedule, finite-cohort run with arrivalCutoffMs 25000.

Why this fixture exists: the full 28-order + 12-delivery main schedule is NOT executable as the M3b slice (inbound unsupported); this burst proves scheduled orders -> reservations -> concurrent picks -> packing queues -> READY_FOR_DISPATCH on real main-warehouse coordinates.

Simplifications: no inbound deliveries; putaway units stay idle at occupied parking; packing service uses the configured 90000ms durations; pick/unload handling durations come from the saved execution runconfig, not the scenario.
Both PACK-1 and PACK-2 run as configured (1 lane each); queue waits arise from the 90s service under the 6-order burst, not from hardcoded metrics.

Cargo-C2: centered 680x1220+100 (r799) profile, capacity 4 (2 equipment crates x 2 fixed cells); all 6 burst orders are 3-4 items in unchanged single-trip lines; PACK2-Q3 at (20500,9400); 6/6 READY proven on this geometry with the consistent disc-occupancy planner.
inventedFields: burst order ids, arrivals, and quantities; run mode and cutoff

provenance.description: Main LayoutLab operations warehouse: 24x18 m room, 6 racks, 24 modeled shelf slots, 12 products, 6 mobile units, receiving + 2 packing + dispatch resources, 28 orders + 12 deliveries. Static environment part; engine-owned motion arrives separately.
assumptions: Fixed-orientation storage: item width/depth/height each fit the usable box with no rotation.
One handling-unit equals one item (capacityCostUnits 1); each unit carries at most loadCapacityUnits 4 (2 equipment crates x 2 fixed 220x320x160 cells, cargo-c2 model).
Each modeled slot is dedicated to one product (eligibleProductIds singleton); maxQuantity is that slot filled to its configured container grid.
L24 is a configured P11 overflow slot with zero initial stock; it renders empty.
Staging obstacle rectangles are reserved floor (keep-clear), rendered as empty floor markings with no goods.
Entrance carpet_floor_01 is a flat floor finish visual, not a registered obstruction; door side bodies and barrier posts are registered.
Walls and entrance wall bodies lie outside the planning boundary and are display-only cutaway shell (clipped above 2.5 m).
All coordinates are explicit in this fixture; the renderer adds no hidden positions.

M3a correction (2026-11-03): PACK-1/PACK-2 serviceCapacity 2->1 (one physical lane each, two stations/tables preserved); historical fixture sha256 31e8b3429183abf8636b47c5b00f2c0b81dd0d8a4e0fac42c3faf9e303320b4e.

M3a correction: PACK queue slots repositioned to the x22500 east line (PACK1 z6900/8400/9900, PACK2 z11400/12900/14400) for 1500mm pairwise clearance under the 600mm radius (old 600mm pitch overlapped); counts/capacities preserved except the explicit 2->1; racks/tables/entrances/obstacles unchanged.

Cargo-C2 correction (2026-11-03): mobile profile 600x800+100 (r600) -> centered 680x1220+100 (r799) for the integrated SimReady cart_luggage_platform_a01 + 2 crate_blue_a01 equipment docks (carry packet assets/cargo/carry-luggage-platform-a01.json); loadCapacityUnits 96 -> 4 conservative handling units; the M3a/M3b-geometry revision sha256 ce33a9c5a77300f998c05c5452ed1c04eb9a6bd38d5e0c0eace5fb64d6edadef (22374 bytes) is preserved in git history and oracles, never rewritten.

Cargo-C2 slots: RCV-Q1 x2300, RCV-Q2 (900,13200); PACK1-Q z6900/8600/10300 on x22500; PACK2-Q (22500,12000)/(22500,13700)/(20500,9400); DSP-S1 x19900, DSP-Q1 x18200, DSP-Q2 (16400,14000); all 20 service/queue/parking pairwise >1598 (min 1615.55 PACK2-S1/DSP-S1), all 44 points navigable at r799; racks/tables/entrances/obstacles/approaches/stock/products/orders/deliveries/service-durations/handling-durations unchanged.
Main-schedule orders above 4u need future split-trip work under the honest capacity-4 model; they are never executed in-slice (inbound unsupported) and their lines are unchanged.
inventedFields: all dimensions, positions, quantities, schedules, and durations
